subject: ophthalmology
title: Posterior uveitis, panuveitis and endophthalmitis

steps.tx: **Intermediate uveitis** (pars planitis) snows the inferior vitreous (snowballs) with snowbank exudates over pars plana in young adults, often idiopathic or with multiple sclerosis, sarcoid or Lyme associations; cystoid macular oedema blurs central vision. Periocular or systemic steroids with immunosuppression control persistent oedema, and pars plana vitrectomy clears debris in selected cases. Multiple sclerosis linkage mandates neurology review of white matter symptoms.
steps.say: Snowballs low in vitreous with swollen macula in young adult: intermediate uveitis. Ask about multiple sclerosis.

steps.tx: **Toxoplasmosis** causes the commonest infectious posterior uveitis: recurrent focal necrotising retinochoroiditis beside old pigmented scars (satellite lesions) with overlying vitritis (headlight in fog), from congenital or acquired Toxoplasma gondii. Active edges get pyrimethamine with sulfadiazine (folinic rescue) plus steroids, or trimethoprim sulfamethoxazole and azithromycin patterns; pregnancy and immunocompromise need specialist regimens. Cytomegalovirus retinitis (pizza pie haemorrhagic necrosis in AIDS with low CD4), acute retinal necrosis (herpetic peripheral whitening) and ocular tuberculosis complete infectious patterns.
steps.say: Old scar with fresh fluffy edge in foggy vitreous: toxoplasmosis. Treat parasites before steroids.

steps.tx: Systemic vasculitic patterns: **Behcet disease** (oral plus genital ulcers with hypopyon uveitis and retinal vasculitis along silk route populations) needs aggressive immunosuppression with biologics to prevent blinding occlusions; **Vogt Koyanagi Harada disease** (bilateral exudative detachments with disc swelling, vitiligo, poliosis, meningismus after viral prodrome in pigmented races) needs prolonged high dose steroids with steroid sparing agents to prevent sunset glow fundus. Sympathetic ophthalmia and sarcoid panuveitis join bilateral granulomatous patterns. Fluorescein angiography maps vasculitis and ischaemia guiding laser.
steps.say: Mouth plus genital sores plus hypopyon: Behcet. Vitiligo plus bilateral detachments: VKH.

steps.tx: **Endophthalmitis** divides exogenous (postoperative acute within days, bleb related, post traumatic with Bacillus ferocity, endogenous septic emboli in diabetics or immunosuppressed with bilateral potential) from sterile inflammation by pain, vision crash, lid swelling, hypopyon and dense vitritis obscuring fundus. Vitreous tap with intravitreal vancomycin and ceftazidime (plus dexamethasone debates) starts immediately; early vitrectomy benefits severe postoperative cases. Prophylaxis is povidone iodine prep with intracameral antibiotics at cataract surgery. Sympathetic and toxic anterior segment syndromes mimic early but lack vitritis.
steps.say: Pain plus no fundus view after surgery or trauma: tap vitreous, inject antibiotics now.
